name: AstiVita Limited
summary: AstiVita Limited imports and distributes household, consumer, appliances, and renewable energy products in Australia. The company offers bathroom products, photovoltaic panels, and other household and consumer goods products. It also provides beauty products; and health and wellness products, such as air purifiers, oil diffusers, foam cushion, laptop table, Bluetooth scales, infrared thermometer, and sleeping pads, as well as sunscreen lotion and wand massagers. The company was formerly known as AstiVita Renewables Limited and changed its name to AstiVita Limited in December 2013. AstiVita Limited was founded in 2004 and is based in Rocklea, Australia. AstiVita Limited operates as a subsidiary of RAINROSE PTY LTD
